title: UI-01 Scope and history
scope_and_acceptance: Replace implicit PDF/page scope in `assets/app.js`; add explicit controls and API scope validation in `src/nsai/api.py`. Opening a citation cannot alter question scope; cross-user, deleted and replaced documents remain denied. Default library scope implemented; authorization integration remains open.

title: UI-02 Anchor contract
scope_and_acceptance: Extend persisted source/citation lineage with versioned selectors and reversible normalization. Original bytes and source spans remain immutable. Test Unicode, repeated phrases, columns, truncation and stale generations independently.

title: UI-03 Viewer positioning
scope_and_acceptance: Add pinned local text-layer assets, bounded matching, native DOM-range overlays and labeled OCR fallback. Bundle font data with provenance. Test zoom/rotation/DPR, keyboard navigation, cancellation and no false exact labels. Use labeled fallback; exact positioning still requires verification.

title: UI-04 Durable semantic jobs
scope_and_acceptance: Add migration, transactional enqueue/activation, bounded CPU worker and queue status. Test crashes, retry limits, duplicate upload, model mismatch, deletion, replacement, queue saturation and backup/restore. No global semantic activation before its own admission.

title: UI-05 Unified retrieval
scope_and_acceptance: Encode natural-language questions server-side; merge lexical/semantic candidates with explicit source scope. Prove no silent library truncation, no ACL leakage and stable lineage. Compare against lexical and semantic baselines on independent labels.

title: UI-06 Grounded answers
scope_and_acceptance: Connect ordinary Ask to retrieval and schema-constrained explanation. Validate claim/source support, comparison attribution, no-evidence handling, conflicts and prompt injection. Retain honest partial extraction warnings. Use clarification or abstention when support is insufficient.

title: UI-07 Knowledge navigation
scope_and_acceptance: Expose structured passages, typed formula candidates, semantic neighborhoods, engineering issue flows and candidate-memory status without presenting similarity as entailment or promoting memory to canon. Test subject switches and cross-document comparisons.

title: UI-08 Workload admission
scope_and_acceptance: Establish chosen document/library limits across upload, parser, database, encoder, browser and retrieval. Measure cold/warm latency, p50/p95, peak RSS, CPU, queue delay, disk growth and idle residency; unknown cost stays unknown. Use the decided qualification tiers and upload gates below.

title: UI-09 End-to-end qualification
scope_and_acceptance: Run real browser upload through ready state, normal Ask, citation click, correct PDF passage, topic switch, comparison, logout and restart. Include native, scanned, rotated/cropped, mathematical, multilingual and repeated-text fixtures with independent truth labels.

title: UI-10 Controlled integration
scope_and_acceptance: Bind evidence to the exact new image and schema, perform owned-stack migration/restore/restart checks, reconcile package risk and rights, obtain canonical scan and acceptance, then stage controlled CPU deployment with rollback. Deferred systems remain disabled.
